_comment: The one part of Myra's self-model only a human knows: which models run her. Everything else in her Systems detail block is auto-derived. Update this only when you actually swap a model or move the service.
stt: NeMo Parakeet on the GPU (local faster-whisper on CPU as fallback)
llm: Claude Haiku 4.5, with local Ollama (Qwen) as the offline fallback
tts: Kokoro local (82M); ElevenLabs Flash v2.5 as the live voice when configured
voiceStack: LiveKit + Speaches + Parakeet + the agent worker, launched by the scheduled task SuwaneeGamersVoiceStack with a watchdog
webService: Next.js, served in production by the NSSM service SuwaneeGamers on port 4652 from an A/B slot; dev runs on port 3000
